_comment: Copy to local_config.json and fill in. Only the keys you use matter — leave the rest as placeholders or remove them entirely.
_quarter_target_file_id: Drive file ID for Quarter Target.xlsx. Lets the local Sync button pull it from Drive. Find: open the file in Drive, URL has /d/THIS_PART/edit
_public_refresh_url: URL of the Cloudflare Worker that triggers a cloud sync. Lets the public github.io site's Refresh button fetch live data. Get it after deploying the Worker — see cloudflare-worker/SETUP.md
